theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+1.67%) and Financials (+1.23%) led the market today, while Technology (-2.01%) and Industrials (-1.00%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.39%, defensives +0.81%, and value/cyclicals -0.09% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.26% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.76%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.76%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 4.76% to 15.85, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.25% to $4,710.00, crude oil was little changed at $84.98, and bitcoin gained 1.47% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
